mapper.select: SELECT * FROM filtered ORDER BY started_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

, ranking_records AS ( SELECT * FROM filtered WHERE client_type <> 'ADMIN' ), grouped AS ( SELECT song_id,COUNT(*) AS play_count,SUM(effective_play) AS effective_play_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status='COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_count, MAX(started_at) AS last_played_at FROM ranking_records GROUP BY song_id HAVING SUM(effective_play) > 0 ) SELECT h.song_id,h.title,h.artists_json,h.version_label,h.source_name, g.play_count,g.effective_play_count,g.completed_count,g.last_played_at FROM grouped g JOIN ranking_records h ON h.song_id=g.song_id WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ranking_records newer WHERE newer.song_id=h.song_id AND (newer.started_at > h.started_at OR (newer.started_at=h.started_at AND newer.id > h.id)) ) ORDER BY g.effective_play_count DESC,g.last_played_at DESC,h.song_id ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_plays,COALESCE(SUM(effective_play),0) AS effective_plays, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN effective_play=1 THEN song_id ELSE NULL END) AS played_songs, COALESCE(SUM(played_ms),0) AS played_ms FROM filtered
